scope: native closed transport diagnostics exact two subjects

findings.title: Cleanup wait still erases status-based collector failures
findings.evidence: When _collect first reaches deadline (290), output_limit (279) or debugger_failed (286), diagnostic.failure and primaryStatus can both remain None. If the final wait raises, line312 passes cleanup_unknown to _transport_failure; its lines70-75 store cleanup_unknown as primaryStatus. _debugger then maps returned cleanup_unknown to failure=cleanup at377-378. The pre-cleanup outcome is no longer retained.
findings.scope: Source-confirmed diagnostic loss, not an actual Node-exit cause or unsafe attach finding.
findings.remediation: Retain the existing noncaptured collector status before cleanup; keep cleanup_unknown as the authoritative final cleanup state and retain wait details separately. Ensure the closed primary failure classification derives from the retained primary status rather than secondary cleanup.
findings.missing_regression: An inert real _collect path ending deadline/output_limit/debugger_failed followed by wait OSError/TimeoutExpired; assert original primary outcome survives and cleanup uncertainty stays visible. Existing final-worker test mocks _collect then only faults outer cleanup, after diagnostic.failure is set.
